integrity: The exact identity follows from conditional exchangeability of maximizing-index sets and coordinate independence. The asymptotic equivalences follow from explicit pointwise hypergeometric bounds. Finite checker output is used only as a stress test, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns two independent coordinates. It reduces leader existence to marginal sample-maximum multiplicities but does not prove the open infinite-support conjecture, because a separate analysis of those multiplicities is still required. An equivalent common-maximizer criterion may exist under different terminology outside the searched leader-property literature.
title: An exact maximum-tie criterion for leaders in two-dimensional product samples
